user.title: Battery
user.description: Name the battery and choose where its power or current is measured.

data_description.system_type: AC-coupled: charger and/or inverter are measured on the mains (AC) side, optionally refined by DC measurements. Typical for grid-connected home batteries. DC-only: all power or current measurements sit on the battery's DC bus. Typical for solar/12 V setups and embedded devices.

sources_ac.title: Sources and bank A
sources_ac.description: Each side needs at least one sensor, AC or DC. A fresh DC reading replaces the AC reading of its side.

data_description.bank_layout: Two banks in parallel share one bus voltage and one state of charge; their capacities add up. Two banks in series each need their own voltage sensor.
data_description.charger_power_entity: Power the charger draws from the mains (W or kW). Optional if a DC charging sensor is set.
data_description.charger_power_invert: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging; negative values are ignored on each side.
data_description.inverter_power_entity: Power the inverter delivers on the mains side (W or kW). Optional if a DC discharging sensor is set.
data_description.inverter_power_invert: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging; negative values are ignored on each side.
data_description.charger_dc_power_entity: Charging power on the battery's DC bus. Current sensors (A/mA) are accepted and converted with the pack voltage.
data_description.charger_dc_power_invert: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging; negative values are ignored on each side.
data_description.inverter_dc_power_entity: Discharging power on the battery's DC bus. Current sensors (A/mA) are accepted and converted with the pack voltage.
data_description.inverter_dc_power_invert: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging; negative values are ignored on each side.
data_description.bank_a_voltage_entity: Voltage at the terminals of bank A. With a single bank, this is the pack voltage.
data_description.bank_a_voltage_scale: Correction factor for the sensor (e.g. a voltage divider). Leave at 1.0 when the sensor reports the real pack voltage; per-cell conversion happens via the cell count.
data_description.bank_a_capacity_ah: Ah of the bank. Cells in series do not add up their Ah: five 3.6 Ah cells in series are 3.6 Ah.
data_description.bank_a_cell_count: Cells connected in series in this bank. A 5S pack is 5, measured at the pack terminals.
data_description.battery_chemistry: Stored with the configuration for reference.
data_description.soc_curve: Voltage curve used for the voltage-based SoC estimate.

sources_dc.title: Sources and bank A
sources_dc.description: All measurements sit on the battery's DC bus. A single signed sensor can serve both sides: add it to both and invert one of them.

data_description.bank_layout: Two banks in parallel share one bus voltage and one state of charge; their capacities add up. Two banks in series each need their own voltage sensor.
data_description.charger_dc_power_entity: Power or current flowing into the battery. Current sensors (A/mA) are accepted and converted with the pack voltage.
data_description.charger_dc_power_invert: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging; negative values are ignored on each side.
data_description.inverter_dc_power_entity: Power or current flowing out of the battery to the load. Current sensors (A/mA) are accepted and converted with the pack voltage.
data_description.inverter_dc_power_invert: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging; negative values are ignored on each side.
data_description.bank_a_voltage_entity: Voltage at the terminals of bank A. With a single bank, this is the pack voltage.
data_description.bank_a_voltage_scale: Correction factor for the sensor (e.g. a voltage divider). Leave at 1.0 when the sensor reports the real pack voltage; per-cell conversion happens via the cell count.
data_description.bank_a_capacity_ah: Ah of the bank. Cells in series do not add up their Ah: five 3.6 Ah cells in series are 3.6 Ah.
data_description.bank_a_cell_count: Cells connected in series in this bank. A 5S pack is 5, measured at the pack terminals.
data_description.battery_chemistry: Stored with the configuration for reference.
data_description.soc_curve: Voltage curve used for the voltage-based SoC estimate.

bank_b.title: Bank B
bank_b.description: The second bank. Banks in parallel only need capacity and cell count; banks in series also need their own voltage sensor.

data_description.bank_b_capacity_ah: Ah of the bank. Cells in series do not add up their Ah: five 3.6 Ah cells in series are 3.6 Ah. Banks in series must have the same capacity.
data_description.bank_b_cell_count: Cells connected in series in this bank. A 5S pack is 5, measured at the pack terminals. Banks in parallel must have the same cell count.
data_description.bank_b_voltage_entity: Voltage at the terminals of bank B alone, not of the whole stack.
data_description.bank_b_voltage_scale: Correction factor for the sensor (e.g. a voltage divider). Leave at 1.0 when the sensor reports the real pack voltage; per-cell conversion happens via the cell count.

error.bank_a_voltage_required: A voltage sensor for bank A is required.
error.bank_b_voltage_required: Two banks in series need a voltage sensor for bank B.
error.charge_source_required: Select a charging sensor (AC or DC).
error.discharge_source_required: Select a discharging sensor (AC or DC).
error.current_only_on_dc: Current sensors (A) are only accepted on the DC inputs.
error.ac_source_in_dc_system: A DC-only system cannot use AC sensors.
